data.narrative:
Foundry Robotics, a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company led by founder Adarsh Kulkarni, has raised $19M to date. The valuation universe comprises one public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private peers in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics.

A peer-median methodology proved inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-set comparables; while eight same-sector peers exist, none satisfied same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier filters required for robust peer triangulation. Stage-progression analysis was therefore the sole applicable method, applying a 2.5x multiplier to the $19M raised proxy as a Seed-to-next-stage step-up, yielding $48M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $40M to $55M, with a median of $48M. This narrow triangulation reflects methodological limitation rather than precision: only one quantitative method produced a result. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x multiplier for Foundry's specific subsector and growth trajectory, the absence of comparable financial performance or market traction data, and the limited applicability of the broader Robotics & Manufacturing peer set. Investors should view this range as a baseline pending additional comparable data or revenue-based validation.
